name: rmsnorm
summary: per row r of x[R][D]: y = x / sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps) * w, eps = 1e-6 written as an f32 constant

y.why: every step is multiplicative on positive quantities. sum x^2 in any order, FMA or not: (1+theta_D) (Higham Thm 3.1/3.5); times f32(1/D) or divided by D: theta_2 more; + eps (both terms positive): one more, so v^ = v(1+rho), |rho| <= gamma(D+3), eps = f32(1e-6) in the reference. |(1+rho)^(-1/2) - 1| <= (2 sqrt2 - 2)|rho| <= gamma(D+3) (WolframLanguageEvaluator: MaxValue[{Abs[(1+r)^(-1/2)-1]/Abs[r], -1/2<=r<=10, r!=0}, r] -> 0.8284271247). rsqrt budget 2 ulp (OpenCL C 3.0 s7.4, CUDA rsqrtf) = 4u <= gamma(4) (WolframLanguageEvaluator: 2*2^-23/2^-24 -> 4), also covering sqrt + divide (WolframLanguageEvaluator: ((1+u)/(1-u)-1)/u -> 2.0000001). x * r * w: two roundings. Lemma 3.3 gives y^ = y(1+theta), |theta| <= gamma(D+9); for D=256, gamma(265) (WolframLanguageEvaluator: 265u/(1-265u), u=2^-24 -> 1.5795e-5). A dropped term changes y by ~1/(2D) relative and fails.
